SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS patients_received_sapropterin
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 19021959
)
OR de.drug_source_concept_id IN (
